turns.speaker: ريم
turns.arabic: أَقْتَرِحُ أَنْ نُعِدَّ مَشْروعًا عَنِ الطّاقَةِ النَّظيفَةِ.
turns.translationEn: I suggest that we prepare a project about clean energy.

turns.speaker: يوسف
turns.arabic: فِكْرَةٌ جَيِّدَةٌ، لَكِنْ نَحْتاجُ إِلى مَصادِرَ مَوْثوقَةٍ.
turns.translationEn: That is a good idea, but we need reliable sources.

turns.translationEn: I will research the information, and you can prepare the presentation.
